pick.headline: Gorbachev and Deng Xiaoping normalize Sino-Soviet relations
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of May 17, 1989, carried Moscow Television's live broadcast of Gorbachev's speech at the Great Hall of the People after the first Soviet-Chinese summit in 30 years.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 094, 17 May 1989
evidence.snippet: …comrades and friends, | am meeting you virtually imme- diately after the first Soviet-Chinese summit meeting in the last 30 years. All day yesterday, I and my colleagues present here were engaged in talks with Comrades Deng Xiaoping, Zhao Ziyang, and Li Peng. The previous day there was a conversation with Comrade Yang Shangkun.
